verdict.rationale: LibreChat has dedicated first-party docs describing MCP integration allowing connection to any tool/service that provides an MCP server, expanding agent capabilities with file systems, browsers, APIs, and custom tools, plus runtime management of MCP servers via a settings panel without restarting. This directly matches the story of plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration of MCP usage specifically (community evidence is mostly about unrelated concerns).
